prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1177; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you were involved in in Baytown. Is it all right if I record this conversation?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please state your full address for the record.

A: I live on the east side of Baytown, in a townhouse off the main road.

Q: Walk me through what happened in the parking lot.

A: I had just pulled into a space near the grocery store entrance. I was backing out slowly, looking over my right shoulder, and I felt a hard bump on the driver's side. The other car had come up the aisle fast and didn't seem to be stopping.

Q: Were you moving when the impact occurred?

A: Yes, I was rolling backward at maybe three or four miles an hour. I hadn't fully cleared the space.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?

A: Only a second before. I saw headlights and tried to stop, but it was too late.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you go to the hospital or see a doctor afterward?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon. My neck was stiff and my lower back was sore, and the doctor said I had a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Yes, I still get stiffness when I turn my head, and my back aches after sitting for long periods. Some days are better than others.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to your neck or back?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some general soreness now and then from work, but nothing that stopped me.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just hope this gets resolved soon so I can get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
